mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_tenant_quota ( tenant_key, max_qps, max_daily_tokens, max_monthly_cost, effective_from, effective_to, breach_action, updated_by, trace_id, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantKey}, #{maxQps}, #{maxDailyTokens}, #{maxMonthlyCost}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{breachAction}, #{updatedBy}, #{traceToken}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_key, max_qps, max_daily_tokens, max_monthly_cost, effective_from, effective_to, breach_action, updated_by, trace_id, updated_at FROM tb_tenant_quota WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND effective_from <= #{at} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{at}) ORDER BY effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
